svg.title: haibibi-23 approved-style editable pixel art
svg.desc: New art-directed pixel-cluster redraw from original artboard 23, following the user-approved character style. Each visible pixel is an independent editable 1 by 1 square. Flat palette, transparent background, opaque white face and body. No raster embedding, gradients, filters or opacity. Original pose and props are retained subject to the documented visual QA ledger.
